name: 皮尔逊相关系数计算器

map.两变量线性相关强度。: Strength of the linear relationship between two variables.
map.📖 查看「皮尔逊相关系数计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pearson Correlation Coefficient Calculator User Guide"
map.皮尔逊相关系数 r 用两变量离差乘积之和除以各自离差平方和之积的平方根，衡量线性: The Pearson correlation coefficient r divides the sum of the cross-products of deviations by the square root of the product of the sums of squared deviations, measuring the strength and direction of the linear association: r ranges from −1 to 1, a larger absolute value means a stronger linear relationship and the sign shows whether the correlation is positive or negative. r = 0 means no linear correlation.
map.|r|越接近 1 线性相关越强。: The closer |r| is to 1, the stronger the linear correlation.
map.两变量线性相关：r=Σ(x−x̄)(y−ȳ)/√(Σ(x−x̄)²Σ(y−ȳ)²: Linear correlation between two variables: r=Σ(x−x̄)(y−ȳ)/√(Σ(x−x̄)²Σ(y−ȳ)²).
map.判断线性相关方向与强度（−1 至 1）。: Determines the direction and strength of linear correlation (−1 to 1).
map.r≈0 表示线性无关联，但可能存在非线性关系（需看图）。: r≈0 means no linear association, although a nonlinear relationship may still exist (check the plot).
map.一般 |r|>0.7 强、0.4–0.7 中、<0.4 弱（经验）。但需: As a rule of thumb |r|>0.7 is strong, 0.4-0.7 moderate and below 0.4 weak, though judgement also requires
map.不能。冰淇淋销量与溺水相关，但共同受温度驱动，相关≠因果。: No. Ice cream sales correlate with drownings, yet both are driven by temperature: correlation is not causation.
